purpose: Model-scale replication within Qwen2.5; this is not an independent model-family replication.
paired_comparisons: 1.5B minus 0.5B accuracy at each depth with paired bootstrap intervals
1.5B minus 0.5B EAR@K and P-EAR with paired bootstrap intervals
discordant question counts and Jaccard overlap for any-reversal sets
question-clustered difference in adjacent-transition EAR and BCR

hypotheses.primary: At least one harmful correct-to-incorrect transition occurs in the 1.5B condition.
hypotheses.comparative: Differences from the 0.5B condition are estimated two-sided; no direction is preregistered.

exclusions: No question is excluded based on its answer or effect on a metric.
A run may be replaced only for a documented technical failure, corrupted artifact, or protocol mismatch.
All 100 IDs must exactly match the published pilot and appear in the same order.
success_criterion: A complete, hash-verified 500-generation run and paired analysis, regardless of whether the hypothesis is supported.
